name: o90234

levelValue.description: String to be used when constructing URL to access a tile from this LOD.

resolution.description: Resolution in map units of each pixel in a tile for each level.

description:
Dear GIS team,

Please note that the third level of detail in our mapping hierarchy—identified by the code **L03**—has a pixel resolution of **0.597164** map units per pixel. At this resolution the corresponding map scale is **1 : 2000**. Ensure that any tile requests or map services referencing this level use the L03 identifier so that the correct resolution and scale are applied.
